header.name: Asset Group Design Management
header.description: Copied from Asset Design Management v0.0.6

props.description: An Asset Design Group represents an abstract definition of an asset group, generally, when an engineering drawing exists for a particular asset assembly - that would be the "design". Generic asset can be associated to products, as just an asset design group. Asset design groups themselves, do not get inventoried, they do not have maintenance performed against them.

An Asset Design represents an abstract definition of an asset, generally, when an engineering drawing exists for a particular asset - that would be the "design". Generic asset (i.e. non-serialized) can be associated to products, as just an asset design. Asset designs themselves, do not get inventoried, they do not have maintenance performed against them.
